package.description: Include everyone in your math classroom

en-US.description: Include everyone in your math classroom
en-US.longDescription: Equatio is an advanced equation editor used by millions of K-12 teachers and students. It makes math digital and accessible. Students can speak, draw, or type problems and equations directly onto their devices. Teachers can use Equatio to save time when it comes to creating accessible math lessons and assessments.
en-US.name: Equatio

zh-CN.description: 让每个人都能参与数学课堂
zh-CN.longDescription: Equatio 是一款先进的数学公式编辑器，已被数以百万计的 K-12 教师和学生使用。它让数学变得数字化且易于访问。学生可以通过语音、手写或直接在设备上输入的方式输入题目和公式。教师则可使用 Equatio 更高效地创建易于访问的数学课程和测评内容，节省大量时间。
